title: Implementation with Uncertain Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2209.10741v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study a full implementation problem with a state unknown to the designer but known to agents, where agents have uncertain evidence privately drawn from state-dependent distributions. This setting allows ``perfect deceptions,'' where agents' reports can mimic the evidence distribution of a false state which cannot also be directly refuted by evidence, making differentiation impossible for any mechanism. This yields our main result: a necessary and sufficient condition, No Perfect Deceptions (NPD), for implementation in (mixed-strategy) Bayesian Nash equilibria. The solution uses ``competing'' scoring rules to elicit ex ante evidence distributions while canceling out in equilibrium, a reflection device that converts low-probability refutations into direct incentives for full evidence submission without penalties that scale with inverse refutation probabilities, and an endogenous ``test allocation'' using bets which separate states b

translated_title: 不确定证据下的实施问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个完全实施问题，其中设计者不知道真实状态但代理人知道，代理人持有从依赖于状态的分布中私下抽取的不确定证据。这一设定允许“完美欺骗”的存在，即代理人的报告可以模仿虚假状态的证据分布，而这种虚假状态无法被证据直接驳斥，使得任何机制都无法进行区分。由此我们得到了主要结果：混合策略贝叶斯纳什均衡中可实施的一个充要条件——无完美欺骗条件。我们的解决方案使用了相互“竞争”的评分规则来引出事前证据分布，同时使其在均衡中相互抵消；引入一个反射装置，将低概率的驳斥转化为提交完整证据的直接激励，从而避免了惩罚力度随逆驳斥概率无限扩大的问题；并设计了使用赌博的内生性“测试分配”来分离不同状态。
tldr: 本文研究代理人持有不确定证据时的机制实施问题，证明了“无完美欺骗（NPD）”是混合策略贝叶斯纳什均衡下可实施的充要条件，并创新性地运用竞争性评分规则、反射装置和内生测试分配等工具克服了完美欺骗问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that No Perfect Deceptions (NPD) is a necessary and sufficient condition for full implementation in mixed-strategy Bayesian Nash equilibria when agents hold uncertain evidence, using competing scoring rules, a reflection device, and endogenous test allocations to overcome perfect deceptions.
